description: Reverse engineering: construction drawing of 2-story 2-bay steel frame
message: Build a calculation model from the attached drawing and engineering specification, then run static analysis. Ask for clarification instead of guessing any image information that cannot be identified reliably.
engineeringSpecification: Material steel: E=205000 MPa, nu=0.3, density=7850 kg/m3. Column members use section HW350x350 (H=350 mm, B=350 mm, tw=12 mm, tf=19 mm; A=0.01739 m2, Iy=0.000403 m4, Iz=0.000136 m4, J=0.00000863 m4, G=79000 MPa). Beam members use section HN500x200 (H=500 mm, B=200 mm, tw=10 mm, tf=16 mm; A=0.01143 m2, Iy=0.000502 m4, Iz=0.0000214 m4, J=0.00000124 m4, G=79000 MPa). Use SI units and the global-z-up coordinate convention. Use only the load cases and load magnitudes annotated in the drawing; do not add member self-weight. Analyze load combination ULS = 1.2 x D + 1.4 x L.
